drhp.business: Incon Engineers Limited manufactures capital goods equipment from its registered office and works at B-6/3, IDA, Uppal, Hyderabad. Management describes a diversification programme to modify its equipment to meet the requirements of the pharmaceutical and specialty chemicals industry, and hopes to expand into the pharma and agricultural sectors as those sectors expand and modernise. Order finalisation for its capital goods carries a long gestation period, and during FY2025-26 operations suffered from delays in customers finalising orders.

No plant, line, site or rupee quantum is named.
